spec_match.rationale: Port of ExtractClipboardData()/OnTextCopiedToClipboard(): min 10/max 1000, subcommand runner rule, delimiter list, verbatim default loader/runner/remote-runner/decoder lists, is_overall_suspicious = loader && endpoint && runner.

interactive.rationale: Six presets, free text, token table, flag chips and a real navigator.clipboard.writeText copy.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Shows curl|bash matching and npm not matching, then copies for real.

edge_cases.rationale: Too-short, no-token, overall-suspicious and remote-runner cases; IsPossibleURL and FilePath normalisation marked approx.

references.rationale: chromestatus, host_base.cc, features.cc, csd.proto, Clipboard API.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless google-chrome via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: every control clicked, live readouts changed as expected, zero console errors / page errors / failed requests, no horizontal overflow; screenshots Read. curl|bash, ClickFix, mshta and base64 samples all overall-suspicious; npm none; 'ls -la' below length; clipboard.readText returned the copied payload.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts token/row consistency and overall flag derivation; copy settled outcome.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; flag chips invert black/ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea with length description, status verdict, copy feedback in role=status outside the button, summary 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Token table scrolls in its region; no page overflow at 360px.

openQuestions.title: IsPossibleURL approximation
openQuestions.detail: Uses a regex plus reserved-TLD exclusion instead of url_formatter::FixupURL + the public-suffix list; edge tokens (quoted URLs, bare hosts like 'pastebin.com/raw') may differ.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Only DOM/labels were checked via headless Playwright; chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable here (project rule 7b), so the a11y tree was not inspected.

openQuestions.title: No real Enhanced Safe Browsing run
openQuestions.detail: The server-side check itself cannot be triggered or observed from a page; nobody has confirmed end-to-end on an ESB-enabled Chrome 155 desktop profile that the documented triggers start an intelligent scan.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button accessible feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Copy via navigator.clipboard.writeText with try/catch, report success AND failure in a role=status bubble outside the button, clear after timeout, don't disable the button.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: status span outside the button, data-copied/data-failed outline (not colour only — text message), timer reset on repeat clicks. Invoker commands not used — exception: plain click handler keeps one code path for the demo's explicit writeText call.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright: 'Copied 91 chars' and clipboard.readText() returned the payload.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two column tool layout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable and content within its container on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grids use auto-fit minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr); buttons min 44x44; wide content wraps or scrolls in labelled regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain wide tables in a keyboard-reachable scroll region with header semantics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table with caption and th scope=col in a role=region tabindex=0 wrapper with overflow-x:auto.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: m2 screenshot: table scrolls inside wrapper, page scrollWidth 360.
